notes.title: First Look at the Starting Area
notes.content:
[p]...I love good clichés.

Hey Everyone! I hope your Monday was fairly bearable.

While churning out some patches for the Demo, (including the combat-sprint-removal experiment which was removed shortly after) - I've been chipping away at texturing the northest part of Wes, which will be included in the Alpha.

For the full version, I've chosen to hand-model my entire Terrain - and texture using trimsheets, for that nice authenticity.
I was pretty happy with how the overall vibe of how the first area is turning out, so I wanted to share a little clip with you all.

Despite beginning in a tame looking mountain, your journey on Wes will take you through rather alien landscapes as well at some points, as you might have expected it from a Ringworld that got attacked by unspeakable beings just a couple hundred years ago.

Let me know what you think!
[/p][previewyoutube="Rgdx_KIA80k;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: A first peek at the Alpha world!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 

[b]I hope this week is awesome so far for all of you.[/b] 

This is the same post I did yesterday on Discord, I just wanted to share it here as well.

I promised a sneak peek of the ongoing works, and here it is (looking like a heap of molten candles) - A good chunk of the mountain path and Ironshire outskirts have been designed and are modeled.

The beginning area is a little bit more linear than the rest of the map will be, as this will serve as a sort of introduction to the world as well - But it will already include around a dozen quests (Already drafted) and several secrets to uncover (and a little village full of NPCs to love/terrorize).

(Not counting when someone will jam a Cauldron underneath themselves to launch their body over the mountain in the full game, or swim around half the island but that's part of it too, in a sense)

Next up I'll proceed to modeling Ironshire itself and \[REDACTED] - then I'll move on to texturing, and dressing the scene.

[i]Once I start working on the more interesting parts, I might do instead a weekly/biweekly/monthly video Devlog, let me know if you'd be interested in something like that instead.

[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261888/aacfb2c1ae4932aacb65254d5211051bf756deb1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261888/fb116166d4016d3ecbb6537eaaace9770bd3f7c9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261888/311862057879feed8b1a9d8a69d20d5303c2998f.png"][/img][/p]

[p][/p][previewyoutube="T31dyT3hnyo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

[/p][p]Work on the level design and quests for the first area are progressing well, everything is noice.[/p][p]Hopefully tomorrow or on Monday I'll be able to provide a little WIP peek at what there is already. It's a lot of fun to be hiding little things in nooks and crannies for you to find. [/p][p][/p][p]Until then, the question of more outlandish Prostethics came up frequently - So here's footage of a more Melee oriented one. [/p][p][/p][p]It allows you instant unsheathing, and you can't drop your weapon + it can't be looted off of you, aside from looking badass. [/p][p][/p][p]And also, I've had the chance to work on addressing some weak points in the combat system, which I'm releasing now in a new patch for the Demo! I still have lots of things to improve on my todo list, but it can be done nicely while the work is happening for Alpha 1. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you guys for all the awesome feedback this week as well! notes.title: First Demo Patch
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey hey everyone![/b]  

Thank you very much for the awesome reception Sword Hero has received in the past few days. It's been incredible to see and read how everyone felt about the Demo. 

Now comes the part - [b]What's next for Sword Hero? 

[/b]First of all - 0.0.11 patch for the Demo is up now - And over the weekend, I will be preparing a [b]Roadmap[/b] and updating the website, where I will have an entire section dedicated to the lore of Sword Hero for people who are interested - and some sneak peeks at locations that will be in the full game.   

In the meantime, please enjoy this awesome illustration @агата (Discord) helped me a while back, depicting the first little village of Ironshire, based on my doodles.   

And as previously as well, if you'll meet a crash, please send me your player.log files in DM on Discord, so I can use them to help me track down the source of the issue.   

Today went away mostly to create 0.0.11, so let me put here the [b]changelog[/b]: 
[/p][p]Fixed Psi getting awarded even attacks miss or get blocked[/p][p]Fixed Radial menus getting stuck if player dies while they're open[/p][p]Added support for 5120x1440 resolution[/p][p]Fixed glowing barrel-water[/p][p]Fixed missing Limb message getting sent multiple times per frame[/p][p]Fixed particles being spawned while game is Paused[/p][p]Fixed disappearing NPC issue and related Crash when ending Pause (DisappearingDarius)[/p][p]Fixed premature inner arena gate closing[/p][p]Arena now checks for any creature inside the Hallway before closing it[/p][p]Added Death message[/p][p]Added Demo end message[/p][p]Removed duplicate lightsource from shop area[/p][p]Tabbed Settings menu[/p][p]Added option for Classic Camera mode[/p][p]Added option to switch off Camera Correction[/p][p]Added options to invert Look directions[/p][p]Added option to have Attack Dir be based on Look direction[/p][p]Added option to select when to have Kill Slow motions[/p][p]Esc now correctly closes Settings/Controls menu[/p][p]Fixed "Controls" text[/p][p]Loot window now closes if lootable container is closed[/p][p]Disabled jumping while using an interactable[/p][p]Slightly increased interaction radius[/p][p]Fixed some sounds not being tied to volume settings[/p][p]Disabled using abilities while crawling[/p][p]Creatures' Inventory will correctly contain their sheathed weapons[/p][p]Added tooltip warning to trading if your offer is worth more than what you're asking for.[/p][p]Creatures will no longer linger when being shot from afar[/p][p]Fixed Item Dupe bug[/p][p]Fixed a Crash related to spawning many blood droplets in a single frame
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261888/6005d0d7f9d20d62b805ef5a7f6125c7e898b076.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Trailer and Combat Arena Demo is LIVE
notes.content:
[p][b]Trailer and Combat Arena Demo Live NOW![/b]

After years of work [i](mostly spent with preparing a robust framework)[/i], I'm incredibly excited to announce, that for the first time ever, the [b]Combat of Sword Hero is NOW publicly available to try[/b], in a Combat Arena with a limited feature set.

I've also worked really hard to bring you the [b]first Trailer[/b] showing the first glimpses of the open-world of Wes, and island set on the edge of the Ringworld, where your adventures will take place.

I hope you'll enjoy this short Demo, as more news are coming soon!

[i]I'll be monitoring feedback everywhere, so feel free to ask questions or just let me know what you think or if you have suggestions regarding the game, I'll do my best to answer everything![/i]
[/p][previewyoutube="1wU3T21HapI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hey Everyone - A short update video! (Especially if you're from Reddit. :) )
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone! Thank you for checking out the Steam page.[/h1]

After almost 2 years of development, I'm finally seeing the end of my Alpha TODO list. Since the flashy stuff usually comes later in a game's development cycle, it is only natural that for Sword Hero too, for the time being I'm just sharing in-progress early footages - After all, all mighty forts need a stable foundation!

Even though I'm only working on Sword Hero in my free time, I've put a lot of care into creating this foundation. This means that all the hundreds of NPCs and monsters that are going to be roaming the island with their Daily Routines, need to happen in a performant way. My goal is to allow people with somewhat entry level PCs too to enjoy Sword Hero, but optimizations will of course continue even after the alpha Demo later this year.

And now, in case you aren't familliar with my Twitter (Where I'm the most active - I'm sharing all my latest videos there, on Reddit things are a bit behind.) - Allow me to show you a little compilation of my latest Twitter posts, where I'm detailing the foundations of the Crime and NPC reactions systems.

As always, feel free to comment either here, or DM me on Twitter or just join the Discord and say hi!
